tools.name: procurement-intelligence_search
tools.description: Search UK procurement opportunities from Contracts Finder and Find a Tender with filtering by date, stage, keyword, CPV, location, and value. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/procurement-intelligence/search. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: procurement-intelligence_opportunity
tools.description: Retrieve full details of a procurement opportunity by OCID from UK Contracts Finder or Find a Tender. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/procurement-intelligence/opportunity. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: procurement-intelligence_buyer
tools.description: Retrieve procurement history for a buyer from UK Contracts Finder and Find a Tender. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/procurement-intelligence/buyer. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: procurement-intelligence_awards
tools.description: Retrieve awarded contracts and suppliers from UK Contracts Finder and Find a Tender by OCID or buyer ID. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/procurement-intelligence/awards. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: procurement-intelligence_match
tools.description: Match a company profile against available procurement opportunities from UK Contracts Finder and Find a Tender with transparent scoring. Price $0.10 USDC. POST /api/v1/procurement-intelligence/match. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: procurement-intelligence_eu-notices-search
tools.description: Search published EU procurement notices from TED with filtering by keyword, CPV code, NUTS code, and date range. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/procurement-intelligence/eu/notices/search. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: procurement-intelligence_eu-notices-resolve
tools.description: Retrieve full details of an EU procurement notice from TED by notice ID. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/procurement-intelligence/eu/notices/resolve. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: procurement-intelligence_us-awards-search
tools.description: Search federal contract awards from USAspending with filtering by keyword, recipient, agency, and fiscal year. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/procurement-intelligence/us/awards/search. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: procurement-intelligence_us-recipients-profile
tools.description: Retrieve recipient details from USAspending by recipient ID. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/procurement-intelligence/us/recipients/profile. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: procurement-intelligence_us-recipients-awards
tools.description: Retrieve award history for a US recipient from USAspending by recipient ID. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/procurement-intelligence/us/recipients/awards. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: procurement-intelligence_us-agency-spend
tools.description: Retrieve award spending data for a US federal agency from USAspending by agency ID. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/procurement-intelligence/us/agency-spend. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "procurement-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: procurement-intelligence_search, procurement-intelligence_opportunity, procurement-intelligence_buyer, procurement-intelligence_awards, procurement-intelligence_eu-notices-search, procurement-intelligence_eu-notices-resolve, procurement-intelligence_us-awards-search, procurement-intelligence_us-recipients-profile, procurement-intelligence_us-recipients-awards, procurement-intelligence_us-agency-spend · Public sink: procurement-intelligence_search, procurement-intelligence_opportunity, procurement-intelligence_buyer, procurement-intelligence_awards, procurement-intelligence_match, procurement-intelligence_eu-notices-search, procurement-intelligence_eu-notices-resolve, procurement-intelligence_us-awards-search, procurement-intelligence_us-recipients-profile, procurement-intelligence_us-recipients-awards, procurement-intelligence_us-agency-spend · Destructive: procurement-intelligence_search, procurement-intelligence_opportunity, procurement-intelligence_buyer, procurement-intelligence_awards, procurement-intelligence_match, procurement-intelligence_eu-notices-search, procurement-intelligence_eu-notices-resolve, procurement-intelligence_us-awards-search, procurement-intelligence_us-recipients-profile, procurement-intelligence_us-recipients-awards, procurement-intelligence_us-agency-spend.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
